## Re-verification of affected stories

CR-1 amended Story 1.4's AC-4. Story 1.4's code is merged and is not edited by this story; Story 1.10
replaces the part of its contract that changed. These cases re-verify that Story 1.4's list/feed
behaviour is intact after Story 1.10's read path lands:

| What is re-verified | From Story 1.4 | Case here |
|---|---|---|
| Global list returns articles with filters intact | AC-1 | TC-API-01, TC-API-02 |
| Pagination boundaries unchanged | AC-1 | TC-API-03 |
| Personal feed content and auth unchanged | AC-1 | TC-API-04, TC-API-05 |
| Response shape parity with what Story 1.4 shipped | AC-5 | TC-API-07 (captures the pre-1.10 response and diffs it) |
| Bounded query count still holds | AC-4 (amended) | TC-PERF-01, TC-PERF-02 |
| Tag association visible through the list | AC-2 | TC-INT-04, TC-E2E-03 |
| `GET /api/tags` still reflects article tag writes | AC-3 | TC-INT-04 |

Story 1.4's own plan (`spec/test-plans/22-articles-api-crud-feed-tags/`) stays the authority for its
unchanged ACs; CR-1 amended only its TC-PERF-01, TC-PERF-02 and TC-INT-05, restating them against the
bounded-query outcome rather than the Sequelize `include` mechanism.
